assumptions.statement: Operator derivations are local to a fixed-topology fixed-boundary positive-Hodge fixed-selector-rank smooth stratum; this is an analysis profile, not a fixed-topology V4 target.
T_B, T_C, H_1_pre, H_M, I_4M_pre, topology, boundary state, and the unsolved pre-write J_trial are frozen at the D4-v2 pre-read stage during each operator evaluation.
The accepted D4-v2 B carrier and C retained-geometry package are consumed exactly and are not replaced by new hidden state or a second adapter.
Core theory constrains a Read-Back class but does not uniquely select the B Riesz completion or the C resolvent specialization; both remain bounded revision-level constitutive candidates.
Finite-dimensional matrix witnesses establish algebraic existence, typing, and control separation only; they are not runtime reachability, persistence, stability, or empirical mediation evidence.
C selected-content counterfactuals remain in the preregistered smooth projector stratum and preserve the H_0_pre resource total; complement controls hold P_M_Delta C exactly fixed.
J_trial is not an already solved J_C; gain, regularity, same-beat recurrence, support, and conservation remain D6-v2 work.
No D5-v2 operator supplies a writer, a complete transition, common H_4, h_4, or a global structural-cultivation result.
A is carried unchanged and B and C are completed independently; implementation proximity, formula simplicity, and present completeness do not rank the candidates.
B remains an explicitly admitted independent nonresource V4 extension candidate, while C remains a deterministic nonserialized sector of C; neither status is silently promoted to core theory.

source_claim_register.claim: Read-Back is a directional current functional of retained organization and present current, must vanish at zero present current, and must distinguish activity-through-retention from ordinary transport.
A bounded Hodge-spectral one-form response is a canonical candidate rather than a unique core law.
A physical current entering h_M must be transported by I_4M_pre and the output must be back-mapped before common physical-space use.
C retained mediation may use T_C and induced H_M but may not add independent C-sector state.
B is an admitted V4 independent nonresource candidate; its operator may be completed revision-specifically but is not inherited coherence-only Read-Back.
Signed B response and C Hodge gains do not by themselves determine continuation stiffness, temporal relaxation, stability, or global structural sign.

evidence_or_argument: The accepted D4-v2 T_B is a bounded symmetric bilinear form with H_1_pre units; Riesz representation therefore gives the canonical dimensionless H_1_pre-self-adjoint endomorphism A_B = H_1_pre^-1 T_B without adding state or a response-shape parameter.
The B finite-dimensional witness confirms nonzero directional response and exact signed-edge reorientation covariance while remaining a constitutive matrix witness rather than runtime evidence.

The accepted C H_M map makes H_1_M and I_4M_pre deterministic functions of the selected retained sector T_C; composing the accepted Hodge resolvent with I_4M_pre and its inverse closes a typed physical-space operator.

A resource-preserving selected-sector perturbation changes H_1_M, the Hodge response, and the physical output on a compatible probe, while a matched complement perturbation leaves T_C and the complete operator unchanged.

The C tau-zero and kappa-zero controls show that mere metric notation or a baseline identity response is not retained mediation; the attributable object is the matched T_C-conditioned response difference.
Independent read-off, direct-structural-off, and gain-off semantics keep B's and C's direct retained paths distinct from their explicit current and future current-tensor paths.
A remains exactly the accepted D5 operator object, so D5-v2 adds no ornamental A-v2 mechanism and performs no candidate ranking.
